# Open Graph metadata for DuckDB

**Parse [Open Graph](https://ogp.me), Twitter Card and HTML link-preview metadata in SQL**, from HTML text or straight from URLs.

- Parse HTML you already have (crawl tables, saved pages) with no network access.
- Or fetch pages directly: redirects followed, only the `<head>` read, failures reported per row in an `error` field.
- Sensible fallbacks: missing `og:*` tags fall back to `twitter:*`, then `<title>`, `<meta name=description>` and `<link rel=canonical>`.
- Relative image and page URLs resolved to absolute ones.

A [Query.Farm](https://query.farm) [VGI](https://query.farm/vgi) worker.

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Link-preview metadata for DuckDB: parse the Open Graph protocol (og:title, og:image, og:type, …), Twitter Card tags and plain HTML fallbacks (<title>, <meta name=description>, <link rel=canonical>, favicon, oEmbed discovery) out of web pages. Two ways in: give it HTML text you already hold (a crawl table, read_text() over saved pages, an HTTP response column) and it parses locally with no network access; or give it URLs and it downloads each page's head, follows redirects, and reports per-row HTTP status and errors instead of failing the query. Results are `STRUCT`s (use dot access, e.g. `.title`) or a list of raw property/content pairs for anything outside the summary. Reach for it to unfurl links, enrich URL columns with titles and preview images, audit social-sharing tags, or extract article:* / product:* metadata.
